items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I played with Louis Armstrong in the Tuxedo Band, Parade Band.

ctx.x: Is this stuff for me to check to see if it's recording or something? Yeah. Okay.

I know Louis Armstrong somewhat the same way from playing in a parade band, you know. You see, most of these bands at that time, what I'm going to see, maybe somebody, others told him the same thing. But they was always shorter men. You know, they never had a full band. If they wanted fifteen men, twenty men, they had to start hiring some extras. So I was, if you could play any at all, it was a good thing. Or, it was somebody always needed you. See? So I got a chance to play with practically all of these parade…
You mean that there was such a need for players that you didn't have to be a very good recipient.
